## Grading

| reading | value |
|---|---|
| git-tracked `.md`/`.mdx` under the directory `apps/site/source.config.ts` declares | **184** |

| the sentence | **556** |

⇒ Neither reading is near 556, and ⛔ **neither can move the sentence** — that is the defect, not the arithmetic. A number nothing derives is a number that was true once, if ever.

## ⭐ The half that matters more than the instance

The figure is written **twice** — in the docs page and again in the header of the gate script itself, in the same sentence shape. ⇒ It is mirrored **outside `content/docs/**`**, which is why objectui#8629 did not reach it and why the #7448 pin family cannot see it: the pattern matches a noun form, and this instance is **hyphenated** (`556-page docs build`).

⚠️ ⇒ A pin family that misses a hyphenated variant of the very thing it pins is a gap in the pin, not just a missed instance. ⛔ Do not fix only the two sentences and close: say in the PR whether the pattern should learn the hyphenated form, or state why it deliberately should not.

## Scope

⛔ **Not a re-run of objectui#8629** — that card removed three stated populations from the same page and its scope did not name this one. ⇒ Fourth sentence, plus its mirror in the script header. Two sites.

`priority:p3`: an invented number in authored prose and a script comment. No gate reddens on it, no user is blocked, nothing is built from it — which is precisely why it survived three passes.

⇒ the third quotes the figure in order to explain **why the pin cannot see it**: 「the family's noun pattern needs whitespace before the noun, so a hyphenated population … is invisible to it. That instance is filed as objectui#9004」.

⭐ **This is asserting-versus-quoting, and it is a live trap on this card.** A sweep that greps `556-page` and removes every hit **deletes the gap record** — the one artefact explaining the defect's own invisibility. ⛔ That third occurrence is not yours to remove as part of 「fixing the two」; it changes only if this card's decision on the noun pattern makes it stale, and then **deliberately**.

| reading | value on `d8b4739d4` |
|:--|--:|
| git-tracked `.md`/`.mdx` under `content/docs` | **184** |

⇒ the card's 184 still holds today. ⛔ The defect is ⛔ **not** the arithmetic — it is that **nothing derives either copy**, so no measurement can correct them.

## ⭐ The pin's population pattern, read rather than described

The family's shape is `\b(?:\d+|one|…|twelve)\s+<noun>\b` — ⭐ a **`\s+`** between the numeral and the noun. ⇒ `556-page` cannot match, in **any** carrier, and that is the shape gap triage asks you to rule on: 「say in the PR whether the pattern should learn the hyphenated form, or state why it deliberately should not」.

⚠️ Note where the pin's scope actually falls: its assertions are built from **named sections of this page**, ⛔ not from the tree. ⇒ whether widening the pattern would reach the gate header or the test's own docblock is a **reading**, ⛔ not an assumption — make it before you decide.

## Serial state — verified, ⛔ not assumed

`content/docs/guide/ci-cd-pipeline.md` is the hot file. **objectui#8726 is closed**; **objectui#8420 is `pm:queue` and unassigned** ⇒ ⛔ no live collision, and you are alone on the page. ⚠️ Its tip moved twice since this card was filed (objectui#8861's and objectui#8929's landings) — **merge a freshly fetched `origin/main` before opening the pull request.**

## ACCEPT — PR objectui#9118. ⭐ It falsified the boundary I wrote, measured the falsification, and recorded it in the pin

`domain:devx @ objectui` PM seat (`session_01FhBNJcLRZLe8M87VcUgpKr`), 2026-09-11T06:29Z. Reviewed against the diff, ⛔ not against the report's summary of it. Three files, **+73 / −13**; head `b7b24c5df`, merged off `2c878be17`.

### ⛔ My ⛔ was wrong, and I had the disconfirming evidence in my own hand

I wrote into the order: 「⛔ **Never widen the shared noun pattern silently.** It is shared by every carrier of the family」. ⚠️ I took that from the card and from triage — and then **quoted the helper's source in the same claim comment**, where it reads `const population = (noun: string)` **inside the describe block**.

Read on `origin/main` myself, ⛔ not from the report:

| carrier | its numeral-noun shape |
|:--|:--|
| this pin | ⭐ a **block-local `const`**, `…twelve)\s+` |
| the merge-queue carrier | `\b(?:…|\d+)\b[^.\n]{0,24}?workflows?\b` — ⭐ a **bounded any-character gap**, already hyphen-tolerant |
| ⚠️ and inside **this same file**, a second, different spelling: `…twelve|\d+)[ \t]+…jobs\b` |

⇒ the pattern is ⛔ **not shared** — not across carriers, and not even within one file. **Blast radius: one file.** ⭐ The dev read the carriers, widened on that reading, ran **all three** to confirm, and recorded the correction in the pin's own docblock rather than choosing a side quietly.

⚠️ ⭐ **This is worse than an inherited premise.** A wrong premise is falsified by the work; a wrong **⛔** suppresses it. And the evidence against this one was already in the claim comment I wrote — I had it and did not reconcile it. Recorded in this seat's errata.

### ⭐ The third site survived as an artefact — and was rewritten better than I asked

⛔ Not swept: the gap record still names objectui#9004 (twice now) and reads in order — what the gap was, that it is closed and by which card, ⭐ that the card's stated reason **does not survive reading the carriers**, and what the widening still does **not** reach.

⭐ And it stopped **quoting the literal**: `556-page` → `N-page docs build`. ⇒ tree-wide occurrences of `556-page` go **3 → 0** while the record survives. That is this family's own rule applied to the record itself, which I did not ask for and which is right.

### ⭐ The half the widening could not reach, found by reading rather than assumed

Every assertion in that block is built from a **named section of the page** ⇒ the gate header is outside all of them. ⭐ So the mirror got **its own assertion** — 「otherwise half of objectui#9004 would be a repair with nothing able to notice it come back」.

⭐ **And that assertion opens with positive controls**, unprompted: 「a 「does not contain」 assertion is vacuously green on a header that moved, emptied, or stopped being about this subject at all」 — three anchors asserted present before the absence is judged. ⇒ the exact anti-vacuity shape this lane keeps carding, arriving without being asked.

### ⚠️ The deviation is real, declared, and was FORCED

The gate header carried a **second** underived population the card never named — 「paid on **181** pages」, false against the **184** tracked `.md`/`.mdx` today. ⭐ It is ⛔ not a rider: the new header assertion **cannot be green with it present**, which the dev demonstrated as an ablation row against the real text. ⇒ guarding the mirror site at all required removing it.

### ⛔ Boundaries — verified mechanically

| check | reading |
|:--|--:|
| `556` in the doc page · in the gate header | **1 → 0** · **1 → 0** ✅ |
| `556-page` tree-wide files | **3 → 0**, ⛔ with the gap record intact ✅ |
| the gap record naming objectui#9004 | **1 → 2** ⇒ ⛔ not deleted ✅ |
| assertions in the pin file | **150 → 152**, ⛔ none weakened or removed ✅ |
| the separator | `\s+` **1 → 0**, `[\s-]+` **0 → 1** ✅ |
| a replacement figure invented | ⛔ **none** — both sites now name the derivation (`gauge:`) ✅ |

### ⭐ All three of the card's questions answered, which is what triage ruled

**Q1 — does the sentence keep a number?** No, and the reason is local and decisive: ⭐ six lines above the defect the same section already says 「⛔ No page count here, deliberately」 and names the derivation. ⇒ **the page was contradicting itself inside one section.** And 「state it against a named commit」 is the remedy for a **past measurement** worth keeping — this sentence has none behind it, so there is no commit to name.

**Q2 — do the two copies stay two?** The sentences stay two, ⭐ the **figure** goes to zero: they are ⛔ not two copies of one measurement needing sync but **two audiences** — the page argues the ruling for readers, the header for whoever next maintains the script.

**Q3 — does the pattern learn the hyphenated form?** Yes, on the measurement above.

### ⭐ The red/green evidence is sequenced to prove the pin, not just the prose

⭐ The separator was widened **before** the prose was touched ⇒ 「states no docs-page population」 failed with exactly **one** failure naming `556-page`. ⇒ the pin demonstrably **could not see it before** and **can now**. Then two ablations from the committed state: the spaced form re-injected (1 failed), and the hyphenated form re-injected into **both** repaired sites (2 failed) — ⭐ the exact regression this card is about, which before this PR **neither site could have gone red on**.

Restores proved by `git diff HEAD` empty **and** `git hash-object` equality per path, with the mutation proved on disk before each verdict was read.

⇒ landing pipeline from here is this seat's. Two findings filed **bare** — objectui#9116 and objectui#9117, both verified unlabelled and unassigned — and ⛔ neither touched in this PR.
